svg.title: Statistical Methodology: Paired Regret and Calibration
svg.desc: An editorial figure showing a bootstrap distribution, an interval plot, and a reliability curve, with deterministic labels for paired regret, bootstrap intervals, calibration, and bounded priors.
svg.text: Paired regret, bootstrap intervals, and calibrated uncertainty.

g.text: Bootstrap intervals over hard null tests.

svg.text: Adequacy should be measured, not asserted.
